english.note: Use 作家 as the all-purpose noun for a writer understood as an author, especially one producing literary work.
Use this when stressing that the person is a professional or literary book writer.

examples.english: I want to become a writer.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zou6 go3 zok3 gaa1

examples.english: They are a well-known author who makes a living writing books.
examples.traditional: 佢係一位出名嘅作家，靠寫書為生。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 ceot1 meng2 ge3 zok3 gaa1 kaau3 se2 syu1 wai4 sang1
